def sharing_gradient(amounts, hessian, linear):
    amounts = np.asarray(amounts, dtype=float)
    if hessian is None:
        quad = 0.0
    else:
        hessian = np.asarray(hessian, dtype=float)
        if hessian.shape == amounts.shape:
            quad = hessian          # already the applied quadratic term
        elif hessian.ndim == 2 and hessian.shape[1] == amounts.shape[0]:
            quad = hessian @ amounts

            quad = amounts * hessian

    if linear is not None:
